findings.claim: Rolling Slam clears packs; Blood Hunt takes rares.
findings.issue: How to play it names Rolling Slam as the clear skill, but Blood Hunt's group is the clear group's main damage source (D-122)
findings.evidence: b.g1s1p1.TotalDPS 50000 against b.g2s1p1.TotalDPS 21000, both role clear
findings.reader: The How to play it section is wrong to call Rolling Slam your clear skill: Blood Hunt does the clearing damage, so lead packs with Blood Hunt.
